# GENERATED by tools/gen.py from tools/inline_editor/common/scripted_effects/rn_inline_factions.txt - edit the source.
# Faction rename. Entry: the diplomatic action rn_rename_faction on any member of a faction (the
# leader cannot target itself), which pins the faction LEADER in ROOT.rn_fac_target and the viewed
# country in rn_fac_view_arr. Rights: rn_fac_may_edit (game rule rn_edit_rights). Checked in every
# effect: the command scope is never trusted. Errors as rn_capie_v1.txt, plus 15: CAPIE too old for
# faction names (no capie_cap >= 5).

# Opening (scope: the viewed faction member; ROOT: the player).
rn_fac_open = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_in_faction = yes
			ROOT = { is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_open } NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_input } }
			var:faction_leader = { rn_fac_may_edit = yes }
		}
		ROOT = {
			rn_sub_close = yes
			rn_fp_close = yes
			clear_array = rn_fac_view_arr
			add_to_array = { rn_fac_view_arr = PREV }
		}
		var:faction_leader = { ROOT = { set_variable = { rn_fac_target = PREV } } }
		ROOT = {
			set_country_flag = rn_fac_open
			add_to_variable = { rn_sub_epoch = 1 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sub_epoch > 999999 } } set_variable = { rn_sub_epoch = 1 } }
			rn_cv1_status_clear = yes
		}
	}
}

# ROOT scope.
rn_fac_close = {
	clr_country_flag = rn_fac_open
	clear_array = rn_fac_view_arr
	clear_variable = rn_fac_target
	add_to_variable = { rn_sub_epoch = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sub_epoch > 999999 } } set_variable = { rn_sub_epoch = 1 } }
}

# Permission and state (ROOT scope); rn_cv1_err 20 when not allowed or not open.
rn_fac_rights = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 }
			OR = {
				is_ai = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_fac_open }
				has_country_flag = rn_open
				has_country_flag = rn_input
				NOT = { has_variable = rn_fac_target }
				NOT = { var:rn_fac_target = { rn_fac_may_edit = yes } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 20 }
	}
}

# Apply (ROOT scope): one field, the faction name.
rn_fac_apply = {
	set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_open = rn_sub_epoch }
	rn_cv1_header = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { temp_var:capie_cap > 4 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 15 }
	}
	rn_fac_rights = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } var:rn_fac_target = { rn_fac_cooldown_active = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 11 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } } rn_cv1_take_one = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_nativeb_len = 0 }
		rn_inline_party_copy_validated = yes
		var:rn_fac_target = {
			rn_faction_name_carrier_set = yes
			rn_ip_cooldown_days = yes
			set_variable = { rn_fac_cd_until = global.num_days }
			add_to_variable = { rn_fac_cd_until = temp_var:rn_ip_cd_days }
		}
		rn_fac_close = yes
	}
	rn_cv1_status_record = yes
}

# Restore the game's faction name (ROOT scope); same rights and the same cooldown as Apply.
rn_fac_reset = {
	set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_field = 0 }
	rn_fac_rights = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } NOT = { var:rn_fac_target = { has_variable = capie_fn_ver } } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } var:rn_fac_target = { rn_fac_cooldown_active = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 11 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } }
		var:rn_fac_target = {
			rn_faction_name_carrier_clear = yes
			rn_ip_cooldown_days = yes
			set_variable = { rn_fac_cd_until = global.num_days }
			add_to_variable = { rn_fac_cd_until = temp_var:rn_ip_cd_days }
		}
		rn_fac_close = yes
	}
	rn_cv1_status_record = yes
}
